translations.web: A big wind storm arose, and the waves beat into the boat, so much that the boat was already filled.
translations.bsb: Soon a violent windstorm came up, and the waves were breaking over the boat, so that it was being swamped.
translations.kjv: And there arose a great storm of wind, and the waves beat into the ship, so that it was now full.
translations.asv: And there ariseth a great storm of wind, and the waves beat into the boat, insomuch that the boat was now filling.
